summary: Strahd's attention (F9): how much he has noticed the party, never shown. Each mark adds its points while its condition holds; the tier it reaches brings his visits closer together (gap: a share of the usual wait between visits) and raises the chance of meeting something on the roads (road_day, road_night). Conditions read it as `attention >= <number or tier>`.

tiers.summary: A few more travellers lost in his valley.
He has asked about them. Bats and ravens follow, and the Vistani who sell to him remember their faces.
He has taken it personally. His wolves pace the roads they travel, and a letter may find them.
He sends his spawn after them at night.

marks.summary: Doru, one of his spawn, destroyed under the village church.
The spawn hidden in Vallaki's coffin shop, destroyed by day.
The coachman he sent to open a door in the Village of Barovia, destroyed at a widow's step (The Polite Caller).
His carriage's escort broken at the Ivlis crossroads, and a horse he had paid for taken back (The Grey Mare).
Somebody cut Stella Wachter's ribbon and rang his bell (The Cat in the Window).
His eyes in Vallaki, Stella Wachter at her window, put out (The Cat in the Window).
Three spawn he made of Vallaki's girls, destroyed (Black Roses).
The Gulthias tree burned on Yester Hill, and his druids' blights with it.
Kiril, whose pack hunts for him, dead.
Baba Lysaga, who has served him since he was born, dead.
The false Brother Anatol and his spawn, destroyed in his own larders.
The spawn sleeping in his crypts, destroyed.
The spawn who keep his tomb, destroyed.
Rahadin, his chamberlain, beaten.
The Sunsword, the blade that was his brother's, in the party's hands.
The Holy Symbol of Ravenkind carried against him.
His own history, the Tome of Strahd, read by strangers.
Ireena walking at the party's side.
Defied him to his face, at the grave or on the road.
Raised a hand against him.
Turned him away at their fire with faith or a body in the way.
Stood up to his test of strength on the road.
Kept Ireena from him where she sheltered.
Sent his black carriage away empty.
Made him leave a fight.
